name: Acyclovir
executiveSummary: Anti-herpes antiviral. Adult IV zoster/varicella **10 mg/kg every 8 h**; encephalitis **10–15 mg/kg every 8 h**. Pediatric encephalitis < 12 years **20 mg/kg every 8 h**. Hydrate; infusion ≥ 1 h.
indications:
## Indications

- HSV encephalitis, neonatal herpes, varicella/zoster in immunocompromised hosts, severe mucocutaneous herpes.
- Genital herpes (PO), transplant prophylaxis per protocol.

## Precautions

- Nephrotoxicity from tubular precipitation — **hydrate**, slow infusion, conc. ≤ 7 mg/mL.
- Adjust in renal failure. In obesity calculate by ideal body weight per protocol.
- Reconstitute with **sterile water only**.

> Never IV bolus. Phlebitis from alkalinity.

adulto.presentation: Vial 250–500 mg; tablets 200–400–800 mg; suspension; topical/ophthalmic.
adulto.dose: IV zoster/varicella (immunocompromised): **10 mg/kg every 8 h**. HSV encephalitis: **10–15 mg/kg every 8 h** × 14–21 days. Severe mucocutaneous: **5–10 mg/kg every 8 h**. PO genital herpes: **400 mg every 8 h** or **200 mg × 5/day**; zoster: **800 mg × 5/day** × 7 days.
adulto.administration: IV: reconstitute with sterile water; dilute in NS (≤ 5–7 mg/mL); **≥ 60 min**. PO with or without food. Topical per label.
adulto.notes: If dose > 500 mg, dilute in ≥ 250 mL NS. Do not refrigerate reconstituted solution (reversible precipitate at room temp).

pediatrico.presentation: Vial 500 mg; tablets; suspension 80 mg/mL; cream 5%; ophthalmic ointment 3%.
pediatrico.dose: IV varicella/zoster: **10 mg/kg every 8 h** (30 mg/kg/day). Encephalitis: < 12 years **20 mg/kg every 8 h**; ≥ 12 years **10–15 mg/kg every 8 h**. Mucocutaneous/immunocompromised: < 12 years **10 mg/kg every 8 h**; ≥ 12 years **5 mg/kg every 8 h**. PO: **80 mg/kg/day every 6 h** (max **3.2 g/day**).
pediatrico.administration: IV ≥ 1 h, conc. ≤ 7 mg/mL. PO/topical by indication.
pediatrico.notes: BMT prophylaxis: 10 mg/kg or 250 mg/m² every 8 h per institutional protocol.

neonatal.dose: Encephalitis / disseminated neonatal herpes: **20 mg/kg IV every 8 h** × 14–21 days (CNS/disseminated) per guideline.
neonatal.notes: Adjust if extreme prematurity / renal failure.

stability:
## Stability

- Reconstituted: do not refrigerate (reversible precipitate). Diluted: per label.
adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Phlebitis, nausea, rash, ↑ creatinine, crystalluria, neurotoxicity (tremor, confusion) in renal failure/high dose.
